name: Confused Gandalf
aka: I Have No Memory of This Place
look: Three stacked stills of Gandalf, played by Ian McKellen, in a dark cave. In the top two he holds up a glowing staff and peers around under his gray hat, and the bottom close-up shows his face scrunched in bewilderment.
use: For being completely lost or blanking on something you should know. Captions describe a familiar place, task or memory that suddenly makes no sense, like your own old code or the reason you walked into a room.
examples: Me opening code I wrote last month
I have no memory of this place
Walks into the kitchen with purpose
describe: wizard looking around confused in a dark cave
old wizard with gray hat and glowing staff lost
lord of the rings wizard doesnt remember where he is
three panels of a bearded wizard squinting puzzled
gray wizard peering into the darkness bewildered
origin: Gandalf in the Mines of Moria in The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001), when he admits he has no memory of the place.
